facts.fact: Enterprise reports Egypt began fully enforcing its 2020 data protection law in early November 2026, after the executive regulations came out in 2025 with a one-year compliance grace period.
Enterprise says the new Personal Data Protection Center oversees personal data in Egypt.
Enterprise reports the data protection regulator launched its online sign-up portal in October 2026, which a lawyer said was barely working the week before.
